claims.claim: go get github.com/AltairaLabs/PromptKit/runtime/v2@latest installs the runtime module
OPENAI_API_KEY is read from the environment by openai.NewProvider with empty key args
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is read from the environment by claude.NewProvider
Code compiles: imports and identifiers hooks, guardrails, pipeline, stage, providers, claude, openai, statestore, types
guardrails.NewGuardrailHook("banned_words", {words}) replaces a reply containing a listed word with a policy message
guardrails.NewGuardrailHook("length", {max_characters}) truncates a reply at the limit
An empty base URL selects the provider's default endpoint
NewStateStoreLoadStage / NewProviderStageWithHooks / NewIncrementalSaveStage chain loads history, calls provider with hooks, saves new messages
StateStoreConfig names the conversation, so the pipeline is built per request
Providers retry transient failures such as 429 and 503 themselves
Execute moves to the next provider only when a provider returns an error
Graceful shutdown: http.Server.Shutdown with 30s context on SIGINT/SIGTERM
A second message with the same session_id sees the first exchange via the state store
StateStoreLoadStage -> ProviderStage (+hooks) -> IncrementalSaveStage; Execute falls back to next provider
claude-haiku-4-5 and gpt-4o-mini are valid model IDs
Pipeline output carries the assistant message with CostInfo; elem.Meta.FromHistory marks replayed history
